thread:
elaine: Opening a PR for a 'Provisioning quickstart' targeted at Dedicated capacity. Adds a minimal terraform example, k8s autoscale YAML, a short canary checklist, and a tiny SDK snippet for setting isolation labels. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 — looking for quick eyes from eng-runtime and eng-platform. TL;DR: keep examples minimal, highlight isolation + SLA note.

henry: quick nits — can you add expected instance types (e.g. A100, H100), target qps, and an example burst_policy? Also include an explicit isolation annotation example like `tenant.isolation: reserved`.

sylvia: I'll take the infra review tomorrow. Can we split the terraform module out from the quickstart body and add a `preview` flag in the snippet? Also reword the SLA paragraph: say "SLA applies to reserved capacity only" instead of "reserved pools".

jamal: FYI the terraform snippet currently uses a deprecated provider arg `gpus` — please switch to `gpu_count` for provider v0.8.1. I can paste a patch.

nora: for the canary checklist, please add a step to watch per-route latency dashboards and set an alert at 20% above baseline. Also add a rollback trigger if error-rate > 3% over 5m.

elaine: thanks all — updating now. Draft of the k8s autoscale YAML I'm planning to include:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: dedicated-autoscale
data:
  scalePolicy: |-
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 10
    metric: rps
    cooldownSeconds: 120
```
Is cooldownSeconds=120 okay? Should we bump to 180 for heavy models (e.g., >32k context)? @henry @jamal

henry: 120 is fine for typical 8k-context models; bump to 180 for >32k. Also add a short note about KV-cache warm-up affecting initial latency and autoscale decisions.

sylvia: LGTM after the patch from jamal. Also please add a tiny python SDK example showing how to set isolation_label during provisioning, e.g.:
`client.create_capacity(name="team-x", isolation_label="high", gpu=4)`

deploy-bot: Preview site built for PR #4827: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/4827 — staging link expires in 7 days. :rocket:

elaine: pushed changes addressing comments: split terraform section into "module" and "quickstart", replaced `gpus` -> `gpu_count`, tightened SLA wording, added canary latency alert step, and included the SDK snippet. PTAL — will merge after one more +1 from eng-runtime.

henry: +1.

sylvia: +1 from infra. Please squash the tiny fixes before merge. :+1:
